about: compiler/wasmlower: compiler/ir functions lowered to a WASM32 module through compiler/objfmt/wasm (NB-6 round 1). Every mutant breaks one lowering rule: structured control, operator choice, host calls, refusals.

mutants.name: wasmlower-while-cond-not-negated
mutants.rule: A while leaves its loop when its condition is false: the condition is negated into br_if to the exit block.

mutants.name: wasmlower-break-goes-to-next
mutants.rule: A break branches to its loop's exit block, not to its next iteration.

mutants.name: wasmlower-oror-true-arm-false
mutants.rule: x || y is true without evaluating y when x is true.

mutants.name: wasmlower-signed-rem-as-unsigned
mutants.from: bop("%", false, wasm.OpI32RemS, wasm.OpI32RemU, wasm.OpI64RemS, wasm.OpI64RemU),
mutants.to: bop("%", false, wasm.OpI32RemU, wasm.OpI32RemU, wasm.OpI64RemS, wasm.OpI64RemU),
mutants.rule: % of a signed type truncates toward zero as Go's does (rem_s), never unsigned.

mutants.name: wasmlower-set-op-loses-left
mutants.rule: A set with an operator reads its local before the operand: l op= x is l = l op x.

mutants.name: wasmlower-wide-const-as-i32
mutants.rule: A constant of a 64-bit type is an i64.const.

mutants.name: wasmlower-result-end-not-unreachable
mutants.rule: A function with a result ends in unreachable, so a body whose every path returns validates.

mutants.name: wasmlower-refusal-unnamed
mutants.from: NotLowered{Func: lw.name, Row: id, Kind: kind, Why: why}
mutants.to: NotLowered{Func: lw.name, Row: id, Kind: "", Why: why}
mutants.rule: A refusal names the IR kind it refuses.

mutants.name: wasmlower-host-not-imported
mutants.rule: A file that calls a WASI host imports fd_write and proc_exit from wasi_snapshot_preview1.
